_comment: SWARM addition (M3): the SWARM wallet's Rust addon, one binary per platform, as published by CI on the swarm-wallet-core release below. Too large for git (about 80 MB each), so scripts/swarm-fetch-wallet-addon.mjs downloads the one this machine needs into vendor/swarm-wallet-native/ and refuses it unless its SHA-256 is the one written here. The TypeScript wrapper is vendor/swarm-wallet-core-0.2.0.tgz, built from the same commit. See docs/WALLET-PANE.md. Mirror note 2026-09-28: the Swarm-Official account was suspended, so the release is mirrored under louisinthesubway/swarm-wallet-core; the win32-x64 binary there is byte-identical to the original (same sha256), the linux-x64 and darwin-arm64 binaries are rebuilt from the same sources and get their own hashes here when they land.
